verses.en: Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where the LORD appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.pt: E começou Salomão a edificar a casa em Jerusalém, no monte Moriá que havia sido mostrado a Davi seu pai, no lugar que Davi havia preparado na eira de Ornã jebuseu.
verses.en_web: Then Solomon began to build Yahweh’s house at Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where Yahweh appeared to David his father, which he prepared in the place that David had appointed, on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.en_bbe: Then Solomon made a start at building the house of the Lord on Mount Moriah in Jerusalem, where the Lord had been seen by his father David, in the place which David had made ready in the grain-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

verses.en: And he began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
verses.pt: E começou a edificar no mês segundo, a dois do mês, no quarto ano de seu reinado.
verses.en_web: He began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
verses.en_bbe: The building was started in the second month in the fourth year of his rule.

verses.en: Now these are the things wherein Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.
verses.pt: Estas são as medidas de que Salomão fundou o edifício da casa de Deus. A primeira medida foi do comprimento de sessenta côvados; e a largura de vinte côvados.
verses.en_web: Now these are the foundations which Solomon laid for the building of God’s house. The length by cubits after the first measure was sixty cubits, and the width twenty cubits.
verses.en_bbe: And Solomon put the base of the house of God in position; by the older measure it was sixty cubits long and twenty cubits wide.

verses.en: And the porch that was in the front of the house, the length of it was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height was an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.
verses.pt: O pórtico que estava na dianteira do comprimento, era de vinte côvados à frente da largura da casa, e sua altura de cento e vinte: e cobriu-o por dentro de ouro puro.
verses.en_web: The porch that was in front, its length, according to the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and the height one hundred twenty; and he overlaid it within with pure gold.
verses.en_bbe: And the covered way in front of the house was twenty cubits long, as wide as the house, and a hundred and twenty cubits high, all plated inside with the best gold.

verses.en: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.
verses.pt: E forrou a casa maior com madeira de faia, a qual cobriu de bom ouro, e fez ressaltar sobre ela palmas e correntes.
verses.en_web: He made the larger room with a ceiling of cypress wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and ornamented it with palm trees and chains.
verses.en_bbe: And the greater house was roofed with cypress-wood, plated with the best gold and ornamented with designs of palm-trees and chains.

verses.en: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.
verses.pt: Cobriu também a casa de pedras preciosas por excelência: e o ouro era ouro de Parvaim.
verses.en_web: He decorated the house with precious stones for beauty. The gold was gold from Parvaim.
verses.en_bbe: And the house was made beautiful with stones of great value, and the gold was gold of Parvaim.

verses.en: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubims on the walls.
verses.pt: Assim cobriu a casa, suas vigas, seus umbrais, suas paredes, e suas portas, com ouro; e esculpiu querubins pelas paredes.
verses.en_web: He also overlaid the house, the beams, the thresholds, its walls, and its doors with gold; and engraved cherubim on the walls.
verses.en_bbe: All the house was plated with gold, the supports, the steps, the walls and the doors; and the walls were ornamented with designs of winged ones.

verses.en: And he made the most holy house, the length whereof was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.
verses.pt: Fez assim a casa do lugar santíssimo, cujo comprimento era de vinte côvados segundo a largura da frente da casa, e sua largura de vinte côvados: e cobriu-a de bom ouro que pesava seiscentos talentos.
verses.en_web: He made the most holy place. Its length, according to the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and its width twenty cubits; and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.
verses.en_bbe: And he made the most holy place; it was twenty cubits long, and twenty cubits wide, like the greater house, and was plated all over with the best gold; six hundred talents were used for it.

verses.en: And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.
verses.pt: E o peso dos pregos teve cinquenta siclos de ouro. Cobriu também de ouro as salas.
verses.en_web: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. He overlaid the upper rooms with gold.
verses.en_bbe: And fifty shekels weight of gold was used for the nails. He had all the higher rooms plated with gold.

verses.en: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.pt: E dentro do lugar santíssimo fez dois querubins esculpidos, os quais cobriram de ouro.
verses.en_web: In the most holy place he made two cherubim by carving; and they overlaid them with gold.
verses.en_bbe: And in the most holy place he made images of two winged beings, covering them with gold.

verses.en: And the wings of the cherubims were twenty cubits long: one wing of the one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was likewise five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.pt: O comprimento das asas dos querubins era de vinte côvados: porque a uma asa era de cinco côvados: a qual chegava até a parede da casa; e a outra asa de cinco côvados, a qual chegava à asa do outro querubim.
verses.en_web: The wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long: the wing of the one was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.en_bbe: Their outstretched wings were twenty cubits across; one wing, five cubits long, touching the wall of the house, and the other, of the same size, meeting the wing of the other winged one.

verses.en: And one wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was five cubits also, joining to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.pt: Da mesma maneira a uma asa do outro querubim era de cinco côvados: a qual chegava até a parede da casa; e a outra asa era de cinco côvados, que tocava a asa do outro querubim.
verses.en_web: The wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, joining to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.en_bbe: And in the same way, the wings of the other, five cubits long, were stretched out, one touching the wall and the other meeting the wing of the first winged one.

verses.en: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were inward.
verses.pt: Assim as asas destes querubins estavam estendidas por vinte côvados: e eles estavam em pé com os rostos até a casa.
verses.en_web: The wings of these cherubim spread themselves out twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house.
verses.en_bbe: Their outstretched wings were twenty cubits across; they were placed upright on their feet, facing the inner part of the house.

verses.en: And he made the vail of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubims thereon.
verses.pt: Fez também o véu de azul, púrpura, carmesim e linho, e fez ressaltar em ele querubins.
verses.en_web: He made the veil of blue, purple, crimson, and fine linen, and ornamented it with cherubim.
verses.en_bbe: And he made the veil of blue and purple and red, of the best linen, worked with winged ones.

verses.en: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the chapiter that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.
verses.pt: Diante da casa fez duas colunas de trinta e cinco côvados de comprimento, com seus capitéis encima, de cinco côvados.
verses.en_web: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty-five cubits height, and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.
verses.en_bbe: And in front of the house he made two pillars, thirty-five cubits high, with crowns on the tops of them, five cubits high.

verses.en: And he made chains, as in the oracle, and put them on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
verses.pt: Fez também correntes, como no compartimento interno, e as pôs sobre os capitéis das colunas: e fez cem romãs, as quais pôs nas correntes.
verses.en_web: He made chains in the inner sanctuary, and put them on the tops of the pillars; and he made one hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
verses.en_bbe: And he made chains, like neck ornaments, and put them on the tops of the pillars, and a hundred apples on the chains.

verses.en: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
verses.pt: E assentou as colunas diante do templo, a uma à mão direita, e a outra à esquerda; e à da mão direita chamou Jaquim, e à da esquerda, Boaz.
verses.en_web: He set up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
verses.en_bbe: He put up the pillars in front of the Temple, one on the right side and one on the left, naming the one on the right Jachin and that on the left Boaz.
